dewalt-20v-max-drill-impact-combo: DEWALT's DCK240C2 is the cordless pair many DIYers and handymen start with. You get a drill and an impact driver plus 2 batteries, a charger and a bag, so nothing else is needed to get to work. It is an Amazon's Choice kit that sells by the thousands each month.
craftsman-v20-drill-impact-set: A full drill and impact kit for less than the DEWALT version, which makes it a good first cordless set. It comes with 2 batteries, a charger, a bag and LED work lights. It is a solid fit for home DIY and light jobs.
dewalt-flextorq-40-piece-bit-set: Once you own an impact driver, these are the bits you need next. FlexTorq bits are built for impact drivers, and the DEWALT name means fewer worries about stripped tips. The storage case keeps the set together.
dewalt-14-piece-drill-bit-set: A basic, low-cost bit set for anyone who just bought a drill. It covers wood, metal and plastic, and the 3-flats shank helps the bits stay put in the chuck. It is an easy add-on to any drill kit.
ework-3-4-cordless-impact-wrench: A brushless 3/4 inch impact wrench rated in the 1500 ft-lbs class for lug nuts, trailers and heavy DIY. It handles jobs that are hard by hand at a deal-friendly price. It is a lesser-known brand than DEWALT or Milwaukee, so check recent reviews before you buy.
diytoolifz-1-2-impact-wrench-dewalt-20v: If you already own DeWalt 20V batteries, this bare tool adds a high-torque impact wrench rated at 1700 ft-lbs with 4 modes. It is a good value for auto work and garage DIY. Remember it comes without batteries or a charger.
coquimbo-rechargeable-led-work-light: A 2-pack of rechargeable work lights with magnetic bases that stick under the hood, under the sink or in a dark job box. They turn 360 degrees and charge over USB-C. They are handy for tool owners and drivers alike.
dewalt-tstak-16-tool-bag: A hard-bottom tote with a waterproof base and tough 1680D fabric to keep your drill, bits and tools together. It stacks with other TSTAK gear. It is an Amazon's Choice pick for carrying a jobsite kit.
klein-tools-32500-11-in-1-screwdriver: One Klein driver covers Phillips, slotted, Torx and square tips plus 3 nut driver sizes. It is a jobsite staple with a cushion grip, bought by thousands of people every month. It makes a great low-cost gift for anyone who fixes things.
mechanix-wear-original-work-gloves: Classic mechanic gloves that give you grip without bulk, made of synthetic leather. They work with touchscreens and go in the washing machine. They are good for DIY, auto work and light jobsite use.
andery-magsafe-car-phone-mount: A one-hand MagSafe car mount for drivers who run navigation and delivery apps all day. Strong suction (rated 78+ lb) and 2400gf magnets help keep the phone in place on hard stops, and it turns 360 degrees. Check your dash first, since some cars suit a vent mount better.
anker-737-power-bank-powercore-24k: A 24,000mAh Anker bank with up to 140W output, enough to charge a laptop as well as a phone and tablet. It is sized to be flight-safe and built for long shifts. If you only charge a phone, a smaller bank may be enough.
olarhike-portable-tire-inflator: Top off a low tire anywhere instead of hunting for a gas station air pump. It runs cordless on its 6000mAh battery or from your car's 12V outlet, and it shuts off on its own at the set pressure. It is a smart part of any car emergency kit.
noco-boost-gb40-jump-starter: Jump a dead battery yourself instead of waiting for help. The NOCO GB40 is a 1000A lithium jump pack for gas engines up to 6.0L, with a spark-proof design, an LED light and USB charging. It is small enough for the glovebox.
drop-stop-car-seat-gap-filler-2-pack: The original Shark Tank seat gap filler stops phones, keys and change from falling between the seat and console. The 2-pack covers both front seats and includes an LED and slide pad. Some cars need a little trimming for a good fit.
redtiger-f7n-touch-4k-dash-cam: A front and rear 4K dash cam that records proof for insurance claims, rideshare and delivery driving. It has WiFi and GPS and comes with a 128GB card. Plan a little time for the install.
bestek-300w-car-power-inverter: Turns your car's 12V outlet into 2 regular AC outlets plus dual USB, so you can run a laptop or chargers on the road. BESTEK is a long-time name in inverters. At 300W it is meant for small devices, not big loads.
lisen-69w-usb-c-car-charger-2-pack: A 2-pack of small dual-port car chargers, one for each car or one as a spare. The USB-C PD 36W port fast-charges phones, and the aluminum shell sits nearly flush with the outlet. It is an Amazon's Choice pick at a low price.
insulated-food-delivery-bag-17l: A compact insulated tote for DoorDash, Uber Eats and other food runs. It keeps orders hot or cold across multiple stops, and the zip top holds the heat in. It costs far less than a bulky cooler.
walking-pad-with-incline-handle-bar: An under-desk treadmill with an incline and a handle bar, so you can walk while you work and fold it away afterward. It runs from 0.6 to 7.6 MPH and is rated for 350 lb. Treadmills are heavy, so check the return policy.
eufy-robot-vacuum-11s-max: A quiet, super-thin robot vacuum with 2000Pa suction that handles daily floor cleaning and pet hair. It docks and charges itself. It is an older model without the room mapping of flagship robots, which keeps the price low.
westinghouse-epx3500-pressure-washer: A compact electric pressure washer for driveways, decks, siding and cars. It reaches 2500 max PSI at 1.76 GPM and comes with 5 nozzles. Electric means no gas or oil to deal with, which suits garages and smaller homes.
saker-mini-chainsaw-cordless: A compact 4-inch cordless saw for pruning branches and cleaning up after storms. It is light and easy for homeowners to handle. Battery runtime is limited and it is still a chainsaw, so use proper safety gear.
anker-solix-s2000-power-station: Home backup power without a gas generator. With 2010Wh of capacity and 1500W output, it can keep essentials running during outages and storm season. It costs more than smaller stations, so match the size to what you need to run.
jackery-explorer-2000-v2-power-station: A bestselling 2kWh-class station with 2042Wh and 2200W output for longer outages, including keeping a fridge and essentials going. It costs more and weighs more than the 1000 v2, so pick it when you need the extra runtime.
kasa-smart-plug-hs103p4-4-pack: A 4-pack of Wi-Fi smart plugs that work with Alexa and Google, with no hub needed. Set schedules or use your voice for lamps, fans and holiday lights. They are UL listed and have over 150,000 reviews.
govee-rgbic-led-strip-lights-16-4ft: RGBIC strips can show several colors at once along one strip, unlike basic LED strips. They sync to music and are controlled from an app, which makes them popular for bedrooms and gaming setups. This is an Amazon's Choice pick.
ef-ecoflow-25-000mah-170w-power-bank: A laptop-ready power bank with 25,000mAh and two 140W USB-C ports, so a phone and notebook can charge at the same time. The smart display shows how much charge is left. It often sells at a deep discount.
anker-prime-26-250mah-power-bank: Anker's flagship bank for MacBooks and several devices at once, with up to 300W max output and app control. It is TSA-friendly for travel. It is more than you need if you only charge a phone.
belkin-25k-158w-portable-charger: A 25K bank from Belkin with a built-in USB-C cable, so you never forget the cable at home. It has enough power for a laptop as well as a phone. It is a reliable everyday pick from a trusted brand.
solar-power-bank-20-000mah-4-panels: A 20,000mAh power bank with 4 fold-out solar panels and built-in cables for emergency kits and outdoor days. Solar charging is slow compared with a wall outlet, so charge it fully at home and use the sun as a backup.
jackery-explorer-1000-v2-power-station: One of the best-known mid-size power stations, with 1070Wh of LiFePO4 battery, 1500W output and a 1-hour charge. It runs several devices at once for outages, camping or work. It is heavier than a power bank, so plan where it will live.
anker-735-gan-charger-nano-ii-65w: One compact Anker charger for a MacBook, phone and tablet. It has 3 ports and a foldable plug that packs well for travel. It is an Amazon's Choice pick; if your laptop needs more than 65W, it will charge more slowly.
anker-usb-c-to-usb-c-cable-6ft-2-pack: A 2-pack of 6ft braided USB-C cables rated for 100W, enough for laptops as well as phones. Anker rates them for a 5,000-bend life. They pair well with any GaN charger or power bank.
jackery-explorer-500-v2-power-station: A compact 512Wh, 500W Jackery for weekend trips, car camping and small fridge loads. It costs less than the 1000-class units. Running a fridge and several devices will drain it faster, so size up if you need more.
bluetti-elite-300-power-station: A big 3014Wh, 2400W station with a TT-30 port for RVs, built for serious van builds and boondocking. It is a premium, heavy unit made for people who need a lot of stored power. Check that your rig uses TT-30 before you buy.
jackery-solarsaga-100w-air-panel: A light 7 lb bifacial solar panel that folds up and is IP65 rated, made to charge Jackery Explorer stations. It is a natural add-on for an off-grid or van kit. Output depends on the weather, and you need a station to use it.
amiss-stretchable-trunk-cargo-net: A low-cost stretch net (35.4 x 15.8 inches) with hooks that stops bins, bags and gear from sliding around an SUV, van or truck cargo area. It is a quick, simple fix.
coleman-portable-camping-chair: A bestselling Coleman camp chair with a built-in 4-can cooler pouch. It is rated for 325 lb and folds into a carry bag. It works well for van life, tailgates, trailheads and the campfire.
bougerv-12v-portable-fridge-23qt: A real compressor fridge and freezer that cools down to -7F, a big step up from basic thermoelectric coolers. It runs on 12/24V DC or AC power for van life, road trips and tailgates. Plan your power, since it draws more than a cooler.
ecoflow-wave-3-portable-ac: A portable 6100 BTU air conditioner that also heats, for tents, vans and small spaces. This is the unit only; the battery is sold separately. It needs a large power station or shore power to run.
bougerv-23qt-insulated-fridge-cover: An insulated sleeve made for the BougeRV CR22 23Qt fridge. It cuts down on condensation, scuffs and heat soak on the road. It only fits that model.
